name: FAQ, oversized questions
description: Numbered questions in large type between bold rules, each with a round plus that turns into a cross when open.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Four things every research lead wants to know before bringing Fieldnote to their team.

default.question: Will it change how we interview?
default.answer: No. You keep your tools, your script and your style. Fieldnote listens in, then does the note taking you used to do after the call.

default.question: Who owns the recordings?
default.answer: You do, always. Export everything at any time in open formats, and delete it for good with one click.

default.question: How do we get people to read it?
default.answer: Share two-minute clips instead of forty-page reports. Teams that do read three times more of their research.

default.question: What does it cost to start?
default.answer: Nothing for the first 14 days. After that, plans start at $24 per researcher, and viewers are free.
